references.as_reported_note: Guarantees and application outcomes are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Adapts conformal risk control to generative tasks and reports applications to conversational AI asking enough clarifying questions and agent-output correctness.
references.relevance: Banked abstention product surface: calibrate an act/abstain decision over generated artifacts rather than treating generation as a fixed classifier output.
references.title: Conf-Gen: Conformal Uncertainty Quantification for Generative Models

references.as_reported_note: Risk-control and utility claims are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Samples from an approximate LLM posterior conditioned on a calibrated high-scoring region and reports target risk control with higher downstream utility than post-hoc filtering.
references.relevance: Forward surface for banked abstention: move the conformal guarantee inside the sampling path instead of only filtering finished answers.
references.title: Conformal Language Modeling via Posterior Sampling

references.as_reported_note: Risk adherence and efficiency outcomes are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Uses distribution-free risk control to set reasoning stop thresholds that limit error while minimizing compute.
references.relevance: Direct peer for .349 fast-path verification: Tier-3 can expose a risk target and compute budget instead of a hand-tuned confidence cutoff.
references.title: Conformal Thinking: Risk Control for Reasoning on a Compute Budget

references.as_reported_note: FLOP, scale, and benchmark claims are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Studies uniform-state and interpolating discrete diffusion scaling; reports about 12% FLOP efficiency for masked diffusion training and a 1.7B uniform-state model outperforming autoregressive and masked diffusion baselines on GSM8K despite worse perplexity.
references.relevance: Operator-seed boundary for EDLM: compare diffusion families under matched compute and avoid treating perplexity as the only substrate selection signal.
references.title: Scaling Beyond Masked Diffusion Language Models

references.as_reported_note: Efficiency and performance-impact claims are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Uses latent prompt representations to crop the diffusion context before generation and reports large FLOP reductions with minimal performance impact across reasoning, code, instruction, and QA tasks.
references.relevance: Fast-path cue for the EDLM seed: diffusion can expose a pre-generation length/compute estimate that the Tier-3 gate can route or reject.
references.title: Diffusion Language Models Are Natively Length-Aware

references.as_reported_note: Benchmark and speed claims are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Introduces an AR-diffusion latent trajectory model and reports Evo 8B is competitive on reasoning, code, and language benchmarks while maintaining fast inference.
references.relevance: EDLM operator-seed route can consider hybrid AR/diffusion transition kernels instead of a pure discrete-diffusion commitment.
references.title: Evo: Autoregressive-Diffusion Large Language Models with Evolving Balance

references.as_reported_note: Planning, math, and code-infill numbers are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Adds token insertion to masked diffusion, reports higher length fidelity, about 60% higher maze-planning success than masked diffusion baselines, and LLaDA-8B GSM8K gains from 58% to 67% after retrofit.
references.relevance: EDLM follow-up surface: variable-length any-order diffusion addresses a core fixed-length weakness before the operator spends a seed run.
references.title: Any-Order Flexible Length Masked Diffusion

references.as_reported_note: Accuracy, token-reduction, and comparison numbers are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Finds a two-phase CoT entropy pattern and reports a CUSUM change-point controller with 63.06% accuracy and 11.1% token reduction on early exit.
references.relevance: Predictive verification cue for .349: monitor process convergence as a sequential signal before paying for full slow-path verification.
references.title: Unveiling the Entropy Dynamics of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

references.as_reported_note: Length-reduction and performance claims are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Introduces Dynamic Thought Sufficiency in Reasoning with reflection signal monitoring and a sufficiency check; reports 28.9%-34.9% reasoning-length reductions with minimal performance loss.
references.relevance: Fast-path process verifier precedent: exit only after a sufficiency assessment, not merely after a fixed token budget.
references.title: When Is Thinking Enough? Early Exit via Sufficiency Assessment for Efficient Reasoning

references.as_reported_note: Token and accuracy-efficiency claims are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Post-trains models to internalize dynamic early exit at semantic-step granularity and reports a 32.0% token reduction on Qwen3-8B versus the vanilla model.
references.relevance: Training-side complement to the .349 Tier-3 gate: make concise high-confidence traces easier for the verifier to accept quickly.
references.title: Step-GRPO: Internalizing Dynamic Early Exit for Efficient Reasoning
